events.subtitle: 30th Anniversary Japan Tour — Here's to Life release live
events.category: Korean jazz / 30th-anniversary Japan tour / cross-cultural sextet
events.factual_description: JZ Brat Sound of Tokyo presents Woong San's 30th Anniversary Japan Tour — Here's to Life release live on Thursday, October 15, 2026. Doors open at 6:00 PM and the performance starts at 7:00 PM; the venue lists an intermission and a planned 9:30 PM finish, with no audience turnover. The announced lineup is Woong San on vocals, Shinji Akita on piano, Daiki Yasukagawa on bass, 大槻カルタ英宜 on drums, Saza Choi on guitar and Takanori Suzuki on clarinet. JZ Brat lists a ¥7,000 reservation music charge and ¥7,500 same-day charge, tax included and service charge separate. Suzuki's official site independently confirms the same six-person Japan-tour lineup, says the tour accompanies Woong San's 30th-anniversary album, and lists only the October 13 Billboard Live Osaka and October 15 JZ Brat Tokyo performances in this Japan-tour announcement. Billboard Live's official October calendar independently confirms the October 13 Osaka performance under the same tour billing, providing recurrence context for priority review without turning the Tokyo date into a one-off claim.

en.why_it_matters: This is more than a routine vocal-jazz club date: Woong San is bringing her 30th-anniversary release project to Tokyo with a defined sextet whose palette reaches from the piano-bass-drums core to Saza Choi's guitar and Takanori Suzuki's clarinet. The anniversary frame matters because the Japan collaboration is part of the story, not decoration; Suzuki explicitly connects the new record and tour to a musical relationship that has been developing around Woong San's Japanese work for years.
en.trip_verdict: If October 15 overlaps a Tokyo stay, build the Shibuya evening around JZ Brat. The Osaka performance two days earlier means there is no reason to chase this exact room if the Tokyo date does not fit, but within the city this is worth making room for rather than treating as a casual fallback.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es más que una fecha rutinaria de jazz vocal en un club: Woong San lleva a Tokio su proyecto de 30 aniversario con un sexteto definido que expande el núcleo de piano, bajo y batería con la guitarra de Saza Choi y el clarinete de Takanori Suzuki. El aniversario importa porque la colaboración japonesa forma parte de la historia y no es simple decoración; Suzuki vincula explícitamente el nuevo disco y la gira con una relación musical que se ha construido durante años alrededor del trabajo de Woong San en Japón.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 15 de octubre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, armaría la noche de Shibuya alrededor de JZ Brat. La función de Osaka dos días antes significa que no hace falta perseguir esta sala exacta si la fecha no encaja, pero dentro de la ciudad sí vale hacerle espacio en lugar de dejarla como plan de relleno.
